body: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a production transparent eight-angle vehicle BODY sprite sheet for Last on Grid in its hand-painted gritty 2994 salvage style. Reference image is STYLE and ANGLE ORDER ONLY, not vehicle identity. New vehicle: Mossling 2019, a fictional original small tall three-door ladder-frame utility SUV inspired loosely by a 2019 Japanese compact off-roader. Boxy upright cabin, short wheelbase, short hood, flat roof, narrow body, high clearance, muted moss-green panels with charcoal bumpers and faded cream roof, sensible rust/scratches and small repair patches. Distinct original trapezoidal headlights and simple two-slot grille, rear vertical rectangular lights, covered tailgate spare in plain square-ish weathered cover. No Suzuki logos, no branded recognizable grille, no lettering, no weapons. Keep consistent geometry and same vehicle across eight views. Wide 3:1 canvas, exact four columns by two rows, equal cells. Top row left to right front straight, front-right three-quarter nose points left, right profile nose points left, rear-left three-quarter nose points right. Bottom row rear straight, rear-right three-quarter nose points left, left profile nose points right, front-left three-quarter nose points right. Every view fits fully inside its cell with gap margin, bottoms consistent per row. BODY ONLY: omit all road tires/rims/wheels; large open semicircular wheel-arch cutouts MUST BE FULLY TRANSPARENT THROUGH TO BACKGROUND all the way to bottom, including diagonals. Do not draw black/dark backing or wheel wells in holes: runtime wheels render behind body and must show through. Tailgate spare cover can remain opaque as body detail. Neutral even lighting, no ground/shadow or background. Genuine alpha transparency, not checkerboard. Match painted detailed style of reference; not photoreal or vector.
dashboard: Use case: stylized-concept. Production racing-game cockpit dashboard transparent overlay for Mossling 2019, fictional logo-free 2994 small utility SUV loosely inspired by 2019 UK compact Japanese three-door off-road vehicle. Reference is composition/painted salvage style only: create NEW utilitarian flat angular dashboard, olive-green structural metal and charcoal molded panels, worn repair patches, rectangular air vents, squared passenger grab handle on LEFT, simple center radio and large practical climate knobs. RIGHT HAND DRIVE. Right-side gauge cluster MUST be a single broad EMPTY dark rectangular recessed area with no instruments, markings or needles, from about62% to89% width,72% to90% height. Runtime gauges will be placed there. No steering wheel: runtime shared wheel placed below middle of right-hand cluster. No logos, letters, text or screens with words, no driver/hands. Wide canvas2.5:1. Dashboard occupies bottom42% with subtle pillars at farleft/farright; top58% windshield is fully transparent. No landscape, hood, sky, reflections or background through windshield. Genuinealpha transparency. Keep enough continuous opaque structure beneath gauge recess for runtime wheel at bottomedge. Match detailed hand-painted muted salvage feel, not photograph or vector.
